999008199.text:
結局、昨日は帰ってこなかったわね。
夜食を差し入れに行ったら、まだ唸ってたし

localizations.en: She never came back last night, did she. When I dropped off the food, she was still sitting there muttering to herself.

999008199.text: 姉様ならきっと、何か思いつくはず……

localizations.en: I'm sure she'll come up with something...

999008199.text: ただいまーっと！
あら、おかえりなさい。いい案は出たの？

localizations.en: Oh, welcome home. So, did you come up with anything?

999008199.text:
思いっきり追い詰められたら意外と出るもんね。
アルビちゃんの新境地、ようやっと拓けたり！

localizations.en: Funny thing—back me into a corner and apparently inspiration strikes! Alvie's just broken through to a whole new frontier!

999008199.text:
ずーっとぼんやりは見えてたんだけど、ようやく
くっきり見え申した

localizations.en: I'd been seeing the shape of something for a while, but now it's finally crystal clear.

999008199.text:
まあ、この発想を実現するためには
新しい装備を調合しなくちゃいけないんだけどね！

localizations.en: The one catch is, I'm going to need to synthesize some new gear to pull it off!

999008199.text: 徹夜でクマができた姉様も素敵

localizations.en: Even with those dark circles, you look wonderful.

999008199.text: もう、ベップは何があっても素敵なんだから

localizations.en: Oh, Bepp. You'd find something wonderful to say no matter what.

999008199.text:
そんな姉様に贈りものがあるの。
これ、どうぞ

localizations.en: Speaking of which—I have something for you. Here.

999008199.text:
どうしたのこれ！　こんなにたくさんの素材！
しかもどれも貴重な、ちょうどアタシが欲してたやつ！

localizations.en: Where did all this come from?! So many materials! And they're all exactly the rare ones I needed!

999008199.text:
それはレスナが用意したもの……
姉様の決意が固まったら渡してあげて、って

localizations.en: Resna prepared them... She said to pass them along once your resolve was set.

999008199.text:
なんと……アタシが立ち直って、必要になるものも
予期していたとは……さすがレスナパイセン……

localizations.en: She even anticipated what I'd need once I got back on my feet... I shouldn't be surprised at this point. That's Resna for you.

999008199.text:
錬金術のことはよく分からないけれど、
見る限り原材料って感じの素材が多いわね？

localizations.en: I don't know much about alchemy, but looking at these, they all seem like raw materials? Like, starting ingredients?

999008199.text:
うん、大元の素材だけよこして、
ここからさらに調合を重ねる必要がある……

localizations.en: Exactly. These are just the base components. I still have to build everything up through synthesis from here...

999008199.text:
錬金術士であれば、自らが求めるものは
自分で作り出せ、ってことだと思う

localizations.en: I think the message is: if you're an alchemist, you should be able to craft whatever you need yourself.

999008199.text:
っていうかアルビーナならこれくらいできるよね？
っていう先輩からの挑戦状、かも

localizations.en: Or maybe it's a challenge from a certain someone that goes: 'Alvina can handle this much, right?'

999008199.text: 先輩からの、重い愛ね？

localizations.en: Heavy-handed love, from a senior to her junior.

999008199.text:
うっす、あざーっす！
この愛、応えてみせやしょう！

localizations.en: Loud and clear! Challenge accepted! I'm going to make her proud!

999008199.text: 足りない素材を集めに、いざ、しゅっぱーつ！

localizations.en: Now, off to gather what's missing—let's go!!

999008199.text: アルビーナ、ちょっと寝といたほうがいいんじゃない？

localizations.en: Alvina, shouldn't you get some sleep first?

999008199.text: 一段落したら一緒に寝ましょうね、姉様

localizations.en: Once you've made some progress, we'll rest together, alright?
